scope: All5282 original candidate10km cells; retain all cells and missing states
geometry: Exact EPSG6933 cell boxes from integer cell identifiers, intersected with GSHHG2.3.7 high-resolution level1 polygons projected to6933. Union repeated sibling IDs within each cell.
outputs: Total land fraction, dominant landmass share of land, centre-assigned landmass share, number of intersecting landmasses, centre/dominant agreement
sensitivity: Existing strict-coordinate island subset plus at least50percent cell land and at least90percent of that land belonging to centre-assigned landmass. No refitting and no threshold tuning.
limits: Static coastline polygon approximation, level1 does not subtract lakes. Not original occurrence precision verification or historical coastline reconstruction. Does not identify real barriers or movement.
